product_meta.title: CozyCabin Automatic Sprinkler Timer, Irrigation Drip Water Timer, Easy Programmable Hose Timer, 3/4" Distribution Single Outlet Water Timer, for Garden and Greenhouse Water Hose Timer
features: ✔Automatic Hose Timer: The irrigation system automatically waters every morning with no programming. Simply set the amount of time you want to water and this timer does the rest.
✔Flexible Watering Programming：Simply turn the knob of the watering timer to set the amount of time for watering from 5 minutes to 2 hours.
✔Easy to Install：The garden hose timer fits for standard 3/4-inch thread(DN20,25mm). Requires three AAA batteries (not included)
✔Application：The programmable water timer is great for garden, patio, lawn, greenhouse, outdoor agriculture watering cooling irrigation.
✔Material：IP54 Waterproof ABS.
description: The CozyCabin Single Outlet Watering Timer will turn your hose faucet into a programmed sprinkler system in minutes. Automatically waters every day with easy programming on a 3/4" standard outdoor hose faucet.
Studies have shown that after using a hose water timer, you can reduce water as much as 60%.
You can minimize the evaporation and save your time and money while making your yard lush and green!!
FEATURE:
Easy to Set and Use
- Just set the timer and go with simple controls, programming is fast and easy.✔
High Quality
Material
- Built with high-quality materials and water-resistant construction.✔
Short Irrigation-Time & High Frequency
- Suitable for spray cooling greenhouse . It is also suitable as a great accessories for Outdoor Misting System.✔
Manual Bypass for Easy Faucet Use
- One-click operation of dial, stylish appearance, easy to setting.✔
Anti-Clog Filter
- it can filter the water quality to a certain extent.
HOW TO USE:

1.long-press and hold the operation key to manually close/open the watering plan.2.Watering duration: 3/5/10/15... up to 55 seconds for each watering.3.Watering frequency from every 1 min up to every 55 mins in a day.
SPECIFICATION:

▲ Waterproof battery compartment with O-ring needs to be powered by 3 AAA1.5V alkaline batteries (battery not included).▲ American standard 3 / 4 inch thread, only applicable to countries such as US / CA using 6 point taps.▲ Watering frequency: every 1/2/3/4... up to 30 minutes,▲ Water pressure range: 0.5bar-5bar (The highest water pressure can up to 10bar, about 145psi). It can be generally adjusted the water pressure in households is 5bar.▲ Working Temperature: between 3-55 ° C.▲ Waterproof Grade: IP54.▲ Flow Rate: 5-35 liters / minute.
